In the assigned HTML preview the entire \begin{tikzpicture}…\end{tikzpicture} block is emitted literally as text; the two noncrossing perfect-matching drawings described immediately above are absent. The capture receipt reports tikz_count 0 and no diagram failures, which does not reveal this renderer mismatch.

diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: Temperley–Lieb trivalent theta network with projector labels and nested cup/cap morphisms
diagram_candidates.candidate: Consider a diagram with three boundary arms of sizes r=m+p, s=m+n, t=n+p; label the pairwise internal bundles m between r,s, n between s,t, and p between t,r. Show A=1_p⊗W_m⊗1_n:t→r+s and B=1_p⊗B_m⊗1_n:r+s→t, then alpha=(p_r⊗p_s)Ap_t and beta=p_tB(p_r⊗p_s), with the closure trace of beta alpha marked Theta(m,n,p). Keep projector normalization visible (identity coefficient one, unnormalized) and do not imply a forbidden root projector exists outside the stated unit-denominator range. The text is complete; this would be explanatory only and is not needed by the proof.

Show composable diagrams A:m→n, B:n→p, C:p→q with both middle interfaces glued at once; track an equivalence/connected component that becomes internal and contributes one factor of delta, alongside an outer-connected class retained in the composite. Check the two parenthesizations give identical outer blocks and identical loop count, without suggesting a topological-isotopy proof. This is only a visual aid to the finite-graph argument.
